products.description:
American Dream Cocoa Butter Lemon Cream is a rich body moisturiser formulated with mineral oil, glycerin, shea butter extract, cocoa extract, lemon oil and vitamin E. It is designed to soften dry skin and leave it feeling smoother and moisturised.

The cream can be used as part of a daily body-care routine, particularly on dry areas. Lemon oil provides the characteristic citrus element, while the emollient-rich base helps reduce the dry, tight feeling of the skin.

American Dream Cocoa Butter Lemon Cream ni cream ikungahaye igenewe gutunganya umubiri, irimo mineral oil, glycerin, shea butter extract, cocoa extract, lemon oil na vitamine E. Ifasha uruhu rwumagaye kumva rworoshye, rutoshye kandi rufite ubuhehere.

Ishobora gukoreshwa buri munsi mu kwita ku mubiri, cyane cyane ku bice bikunda kumagara. Lemon oil itanga impumuro yihariye ya citrus, mu gihe ibindi bigize cream bifasha uruhu kugumana ubworoherane.

products.description:
Asantee Papaya & Honey Soap is a 125g herbal cleansing bar made with papaya extract, honey, coconut-derived cleansing ingredients and other skin-conditioning components. Papaya is commonly used in cosmetic cleansing products for its exfoliating and brightening properties, while honey helps support a soft, conditioned skin feel.

It is marketed for face and body use and can be incorporated into a regular cleansing routine. The rich lather helps remove everyday impurities while the formula is designed to leave skin feeling smoother and refreshed.

Asantee Papaya & Honey Soap ni isabune y'ibimera ya 125g irimo papaya extract, ubuki, ibikoresho bikomoka kuri coconut n'ibindi bifasha gutunganya uruhu. Papaya ikoreshwa cyane mu bicuruzwa byita ku ruhu kubera uruhare rwayo mu gukuraho uturemangingo twapfuye no gufasha uruhu kugaragara rufite urumuri, mu gihe ubuki bufasha uruhu kumva rworoshye.

products.name: Kristal Fragrance Mist (Brume Parfumée)
products.nameRw: Spray ya Kristo ya Brume Parfumée
products.description:
Kristal Fragrance Mist is a fine, lightweight body spray with a delicate floral scent that refreshes and uplifts. It is formulated with gentle, plant-based ingredients to lightly perfume skin without weighing it down. When sprayed on skin or clothing, it envelops you in a pleasant aroma that feels clean and invigorating. 

This easy-to-use mist is perfect for daily use, especially after showering or bathing. It can be reapplied anytime throughout the day to maintain a subtle, long-lasting fragrance aura. The non-greasy formula dries quickly, leaving skin soft and lightly scented without any sticky residue.
products.descriptionRw:
Spray ya **Kristal Fragrance Mist (Brume Parfumée)** ni umuti woroshye wo kwisiga ku mubiri, ukungahaye ku mpumuro y'ibimera yoroheje itera umwuka wo kumererwa neza. Yakozwe mu buryo bworoheje, ikoresha ibikomoka ku bimera idasize amavuta ku ruhu. Iyo usize iyi spray ku mubiri cyangwa ku myenda, igufunga mu mwuka w'impumuro nziza, biguha kumva ko umerewe neza kandi ubyutse. 

Uyu musego woroshye ukoreshwa buri munsi cyane cyane nyuma yo koga. Wakwakira kanda uyisige umubiri wawe cyangwa imyenda, ugahora ufite impumuro igezweho. Formule yayo idacogoza ituma ikwihutira gushira, uruhu rukabaho rworoshye kandi rusagamba impumuro nziza nta nkweto yasiga.
products.shortDescription: Lightweight body mist with a fresh floral fragrance for all-day freshness.
products.shortDescriptionRw: Spray yoroshye yo kwisiga umubiri ifite impumuro y'ibimera, ituma uruhu rutanga uburyohe umunsi wose.
products.ingredients: ["Alcohol Denat.","Aqua (Water)","Parfum (Fragrance)","Butane","Isobutane","Propane"]
products.ingredientsRw: Ibikubiyemo: Alukolo yivanwe ku misemburo (Alcohol Denat), amazi (Aqua), impumuro (Parfum) ikomoka ku bimera, ndetse na gaze nto (Butane, Propane). Alukolo ifasha gukwirakwiza impumuro ku ruhu, impumuro y'ibimera itanga uburyohe ku mubiri, naho gaze zoroshye zifasha kuyikwirakwiza neza.
products.howToUse: Shake well before use. Hold the can approximately 15 cm (6 inches) from your skin or clothing. Spray evenly over the body, moving the can across your skin to cover the desired area. Do not spray directly on the face or near the eyes. Allow the mist to settle for a few seconds before dressing. For best results, apply on clean, dry skin after bathing or showering, and reapply throughout the day as needed to maintain the fragrance.

products.warnings: For external use only. Flammable – keep away from flames and heat sources. Do not spray in eyes or face. Avoid inhalation of the mist. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children.

products.name: LA TCHADIENNE Whitening Lotion Super White Face & Body Lotion
products.nameRw: Amavuta ya LA Tchadienne yo Kuzamura Umweru ku Isura n'Umubiri
products.description:
LA Tchadienne Whitening Lotion is a potent brightening formula designed for both facial and body skin. It is enriched with active ingredients like Vitamin C, Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) and Kojic Acid to deeply hydrate skin while gradually reducing dark spots and uneven pigmentation. The lightweight, non-greasy lotion absorbs quickly, leaving skin feeling smooth and looking more uniform in tone. 

Regular use helps to reveal a more even, luminous complexion. After application, skin feels refreshed and well-moisturized. Over weeks of consistent use, persistent blemishes and hyperpigmented areas become noticeably lighter and the skin's natural radiance and softness are restored.
products.descriptionRw:
Lotion ya **LA Tchadienne Whitening Lotion** ni amavuta akomeye yera uruhu, yakozwe ku buryo aheraho ku ruhu rw'isura n'umubiri. Ikozwe na Vitamini C, Niacinamide (Vitamini B3) na Kojic Acid, iyi lotion izanira uruhu ububobere bwinshi mu gihe ikuraho gahoro gahoro ibibara n'amabara atari meza. Iyi lotion yoroshye kandi idacogoza yinjira mu ruhu byihuse, igasiga uruhu rutoshye kandi rugaragara ruringaniye mu ibara.

products.name: Original Pure Egyptian Magic Whitening Gold Soap (With Egg Yolk & L-Glutathione)
products.nameRw: Isabune ya Original Pure Egyptian Magic Whitening Gold (na Egg Yolk & L-Glutathione)
products.description:
Original Pure Egyptian Magic Whitening Gold Soap is a premium exfoliating bar designed to deeply cleanse and lighten the skin. It combines powerful brighteners like L-Glutathione and Kojic Acid with nourishing Egg Yolk extract and real gold particles. This luxurious soap lathers into a rich, creamy foam that gently exfoliates and detoxifies pores, removing dead cells, oil and pigmentation. 

Regular use reveals noticeably brighter, more even-toned skin. Users report a reduction in dark spots, faded acne scars and overall dullness. The formula also contains Vitamin C and E from egg yolk, which help restore moisture and elasticity. With consistent use, skin becomes smoother, firmer and younger-looking with a vibrant glow.
products.descriptionRw:
Isabune ya **Original Pure Egyptian Magic Whitening Gold Soap** ni isabune y'indashyikirwa ifasha gukaraba neza no kumanura uruhu. Ifite ibirungo bikomeye byo kumanura nka L-Glutathione na Kojic Acid hamwe n'amavangingo akungahaye kuri Egg Yolk na zahabu y'umwimerere. Iyo isasabuwe mu mazi, ikora iruseke rutoroshye rikungahaye risukuye, ikuraho utubara twapfuye, amavuta menshi n'utubemba. 

Gukoresha buri munsi bituma uruhu rworoherwa n'itoto. Abayikoresha bavuga ko amabara yirabura, imikeneye ya acne n'utubara byorohera cyane. Formule yayo inafite Vitamini C na Vitamini E yaturutse muri Egg Yolk, byongera uruhu amazi n'ubworoherane. Iyo ikoreshwa kenshi, uruhu rusubira rutorama, rugakomera kandi rukagaragara rwisukuye, rurambuye itoto.

products.nameRw: Spray ya OUD for Glory (Bade'e Al Oud) Brume Parfumée
products.description:
Oud For Glory (Bade'e Al Oud) Fragrance Mist is a light body spray capturing the rich, oriental scent of the popular Bade'e Al Oud perfume. It combines top notes of saffron, nutmeg and lavender with a heart and base of agarwood (oud), patchouli and musk. The result is a warm, spicy fragrance mist that gently perfumes skin. 

Spray it on pulse points after bathing or anytime for an uplift. The alcohol-based mist evaporates quickly, leaving a subtle long-lasting trail of oud and spice. This unisex fragrance mist is perfect for fans of deep, woody scents who want a lighter, wearable format. It layers beautifully under stronger perfumes or stands alone for a refined, exotic aura.

**Oud For Glory (Bade'e Al Oud)** Fragrance Mist ni spray yoroshye yo kwisiga umubiri ikura impumuro ikomeye y'udukomoka mu ifuru ry'oud rizwi. Ifite intangiriro z'impumuro za saffron, muscade na lavender hamwe n'umuco uturuka muri agarwood (oud), patchouli na musk. Ibi bituma iyi spray y'umubiri itanga impumuro y'icyo muco, itoshye kandi ikungahaye. 

Rasira ku matako y'amaraso nyuma yo koga cyangwa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose ushaka kongerera impumuro. Alcohol y'iyi spray ihita ishira, isiga urwendo rw'impumuro rwiyongeraho pour parfum z'oud n'ibitonyanga by'udukomoka. Ni nziza ku bagabo n'abagore bakunda impumuro zidakaze z'inkonde ariko bashaka spray ifite uburemere buke. Biranogera kuyisiga mbere y'indi parfum cyangwa kuyikoresha wenyine kugira ngo ugire uburyohe buhebuje.

White Express Lait Éclaircissant – Extra Whitening Lotion 500ml is an extra-strength whitening lotion from the White Express range, presented in a large 500ml size for regular use. It is marketed to brighten the appearance of the skin and improve the look of uneven tone.

Apply to clean skin after bathing and massage until absorbed. Use sun protection during the day with brightening products.
products.descriptionRw:
White Express Lait Éclaircissant – Extra Whitening Lotion 500ml ni lotion yo kwera cyane yo mu muryango wa White Express, itangwa mu icupa rinini rya 500ml ryo gukoresha kenshi. Yamamazwa mu kumurika uruhu no kunoza uko ibara ritangana rigaragara.

Yikoreshe ku ruhu rusukuye nyuma yo kwiyuhagira, ukayikorakora kugeza yinjiye. Ku manywa koresha uburinzi bw'izuba.
products.shortDescription: Extra whitening body lotion in a large 500ml size for daily brightening care.
products.shortDescriptionRw: Lotion yo kwera cyane mu icupa rinini rya 500ml, yo gukoresha buri munsi.

products.howToUse: 1. Cleanse the skin. 2. Apply generously to the body. 3. Massage gently until absorbed. 4. Use daily, especially after bathing. 5. Use sun protection during the day.
products.howToUseRw: 1. Sukura uruhu. 2. Shyira ku mubiri ihagije. 3. Korakora witonze kugeza yinjiye. 4. Koresha buri munsi, cyane cyane nyuma yo kwiyuhagira. 5. Koresha uburinzi bw'izuba ku manywa.

products.nameRw: Zwitsal Lotion y'Umwana irimo Avocado 400ml
products.description:
Zwitsal Baby Body Lotion with Avocado Oil – 400ml is a gentle baby lotion enriched with avocado oil. It is designed to moisturise delicate baby skin after bathing, leaving it soft and comfortable. The large 400ml size suits regular daily use.

Apply to clean, dry skin with gentle massage, avoiding the eye area.

Zwitsal Baby Body Lotion with Avocado Oil – 400ml ni lotion yoroshye y'umwana ikungahaye ku mavuta ya avocado. Yagenewe gutanga ubuhehere ku ruhu rworoheje rw'umwana nyuma yo kwiyuhagira, ikarusigira rworoshye kandi rutuje. Ingano nini ya 400ml ikwiriye gukoreshwa buri munsi.

Yikoreshe ku ruhu rusukuye kandi rwumye, ukayikorakora witonze, wirinda ahari amaso.
